dialogues.speaker: Alfry
dialogues.text: The winds are too strong! You need to raise your voice!

choices.text: I'd like to change party members.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Under such weather, eh? Feels like living the life of a born adventurer.

response.speaker: Alfry
response.text: No problem! Alfry will assemble your colleagues immediately!

response.speaker: Alfry
response.text: Now is not the time for self-introductions. Come in and take refuge!

response.speaker: Alfry
response.text: I'm fine! An adventurer like me has to know his ABCs to surviving in the windy outdoors!

response.speaker: Alfry
response.text: Don't get blown away by the winds!
